seo.title: ODUDLAB — architectural concrete for interiors and urban spaces
seo.description: Handmade architectural-concrete sinks, planters, tables, wall panels and custom pieces. Our own workshop in Kyiv, colour cast through the mass, made to order.

workshop.title: Concrete as a tool for design and architecture
workshop.description: Architectural-concrete pieces for interiors and urban spaces: sinks, planters, furniture, panels and custom objects.

product.title: One piece as the main accent of a space
product.description: Coloured concrete in a calm interior — minimal props, with the focus on form and material texture.

quickCategories.heading: Quick categories
quickCategories.outdoorTagline: Furniture and objects for outdoor space
quickCategories.sinksDescription: Floor-standing and countertop basins in architectural concrete — cylindrical, oval and sculptural forms in any RAL or NCS colour.
quickCategories.plantersDescription: Concrete planters and pots for indoors and outdoors — from compact cylinders to large ellipses and half-spheres.
quickCategories.tablesDescription: Coffee tables and tabletops in cast concrete — monolithic forms with a distinctive matte texture.
quickCategories.wallPanelsDescription: Relief concrete wall panels that add depth and a play of light across the surface.
quickCategories.outdoorDescription: Benches, bins and street objects in concrete — weatherproof and built for public spaces.
quickCategories.customDescription: Pieces made to your dimensions and shape — a bespoke quote from first idea to finished object.

colouredSinks.heading: Colour that holds its shape
colouredSinks.body: Pigment is mixed straight into the concrete, so the colour never chips or fades the way a surface coating would.

freestanding.heading: A standalone object in the bathroom
freestanding.body: A freestanding sink isn't tucked under a countertop — it becomes the main piece in the room, like furniture or a sculpture.

production.heading: Every piece passes through our hands
production.body: Formwork, casting, hand-finishing — the whole process happens in one workshop in Kyiv.

texture.heading: Concrete you can see and feel
texture.body: Pores, flutes and hand-finishing marks are part of the material's character, not a flaw.

wallPanels.heading: Relief across the whole wall
wallPanels.body: Modular panels and wall art are assembled to fit the wall and installed as separate concrete elements.

urban.heading: Built for streets and public space
urban.body: Outdoor planters, benches and concrete objects hold up to climate and the scale of an urban setting.

custom.heading: An object built for a specific space
custom.body: From a drawing or a 3D model to the finished piece — we work out the size, shape and colour with your project.

popularProducts.heading: Popular pieces
popularProducts.body: A selection across categories — sinks, planters, tables and outdoor pieces.

colours.heading: Not just grey concrete
colours.body: Pigment is added straight into the concrete mix — the colour belongs to the material, not a coating on its surface.
colours.disclaimer: On-screen colours are approximate. Lighting, your monitor's calibration, and the natural variation of concrete all affect how a shade looks in person.

samples.heading: See the real thing before you order
samples.body: A physical sample shows the concrete's true texture and shade more accurately than any screen.

aboutBrand.heading: Made in Kyiv
aboutBrand.intro: Our own workshop, where every piece goes through the full cycle — from model to finished object.

items.body: Standard models can be adapted to the size and needs of a specific space.

items.title: Our own production

items.title: Materials for designers
items.body: 3D models, drawings and samples for project work with architects and designers.

designers.heading: Materials for project work
